experiences.description:
Built the Human Resource department by establishing process and procedures to ensure compliance, culture, and profitability.
●	Created and implemented an onboarding process for all new hires that improved productivity and lowered 90- day turnover.
●	Established an escalation process, investigating and addressing employee performance issues.
●	Strategic workforce planning to ensure right person right time. 
●	Implemented an annually employee engagement survey that supported the lowering of annual turnover
●	Created an annual performance review in conjunction will annual merit increase.
●	Built a safety program to ensure OSHA compliance and lower workers compensation.

I contributed to the success of a retail location through the support of store department human resource needs. Safeguard talent management and development for retail employees.

●	Develop and train hourly managers to ensure teams are effectively coached.
●	Create documentation and reporting for codes of conduct.
●	Investigate and address employee performance issues.
●	Increase on-time employee training to improve accountability.
●	Communicate district training opportunities to confirm 100% staffing for seasonal schedules.

In this role, I oversaw Operations for 10 restaurants including food safety guidelines and financial management. Managed over 400 team members and ensured proper training following organizational standards.

●	Decreased employee turnover to achieve higher sales and net profitability.
●	Managed performance with General Managers to safeguard successful Operations results.
●	Supported the community through contributions to the give-back programs.
●	Recruited and hired 400+ team members annually on average.
